submission.justification: Module-D2 gives the highest light collection in the simulation at 30% coverage (50.0 PE/MeV, 100k events), ahead of Module-D3 (36.3 PE/MeV) and Module-D1 (25.1 PE/MeV). Light yield rises with coverage, and 30% is the upper limit of the allowed range. Cabling review (meeting notes 2026-01-20) confirms enough feedthroughs for 30% coverage, and cold electronics are validated for all candidate designs. The main open issue is the hard constraint on thermal-cycling failures (at most 5% of modules failing after 20 cycles, 300 K to 87 K). None of the project documents contain thermal-cycling test data for any design. D2's bonded dichroic filter is the kind of joint that can fail under cycling, so this recommendation is conditional: before committing to production, obtain 20-cycle qualification data for the D2 bonded filter and confirm failure rate is at or below 5%. If D2 cannot be qualified, D3 (36.3 PE/MeV at 30%) is the next option, but its thermal-cycling performance is also unverified.
